scope: Durable same-nonce fee replacement and cancellation for the isolated daily settlement coordinator.

decisions.immutable_original: Original intent, calldata, unsigned/raw transaction and hash remain unchanged. Additional decisions/raw bytes are retained in bounded ordered history.
decisions.fee_only_replacement: Only payer fees change; nonce, financial signatures, calldata, gas, target, value and chain remain fixed. Both fee cap and tip must strictly exceed earlier retained attempts; node fee-bump requirements remain explicit operator policy.
decisions.cancellation: A zero-value empty-data 21000-gas self-transfer consumes the same payer nonce. Only its confirmed canonical receipt with no logs and intrinsic gas usage can mark the slot cancelled. It never marks a bet paid or releases accepted onchain payout reservations.
decisions.cancel_authority: Only the dedicated payer transaction signer is needed. No new financial role signature or canonical writer is needed for a transaction that cannot discharge a bet.
decisions.sticky_cancellation: A prepared signed cancellation prevents later settlement sends/replacements through the API; all previously signed hashes remain observed because an older transaction may still win.
decisions.crash_recovery: Decision and exact unsigned variant persist before payer signing. Raw bytes persist before sending. Lost replies never allocate a new nonce or financial authorization.
decisions.actual_winner: Receipt lookup checks the original and every prepared variant. Any RPC read failure or contradictory receipts halts. Included transaction/hash and attempt index identify the proof transaction; original submission hash remains retained.
decisions.atomic_nonce_release: Only confirmed cancellation/revert or semantic payment/void proof commits release the lane/claims. A forced cancellation terminal failure rolled back both claims and lane changes.
decisions.unsigned_retirement: Only an unsigned staged request can be abandoned; it releases neither nonce nor tickets and cannot delete a signed hash.

executed_checks: actual expired prepared authorization cancellation and lost reply/restart
actual pending EIP1559 fee replacement won and provided the financial proof receipt
original queued-void transaction won after a signed cancellation was prepared; no losing cancellation broadcast after inclusion
cancellation preserves LP/custody balances and accepted exposure; no paid-ticket rows
unconfirmed cancellation awaits depth and retains claims
triggered cancellation terminal-write failure preserves claims and active lane before retry
payer-added value is rejected before raw persistence
cancelled original cannot execute with its consumed payer nonce
no new financial signatures for fee replacement
unit checks bind attempt reason, fees, unsigned/raw bytes, hash and nonce; signed attempts cannot become abandoned/staged
unit receipt-family checks detect older winners, replacement winners, contradictory receipts and outage on an older hash
assumptions: PostgreSQL durability, dedicated payer and transaction signer that never broadcasts.
Pinned immutable contracts and authenticated canonical RPC views.
Cancellation does not revoke exposed contract authorizations; another sender can still execute them once according to contract rules.
32 additional attempts is an operational candidate bound, not approved production capacity.
Synthetic fees/confirmation depth do not validate target-chain policy or finality.
remaining: approved production fee and recovery policy
